Diceware makes a passphrase from words chosen by rolls of dice. Each roll of five dice (four for a short word list) gives a number such as 43561, which picks one word from the word list. Repeating this once per word gives a passphrase that is easy to remember and hard to guess. This app rolls each die with your device\'s secure random generator.

The built-in word lists are the EFF Word Lists by the Electronic Frontier Foundation (eff.org/dice), used under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 License (CC BY 3.0, creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0).
Diceware keeps no history of your passphrases, writes no logs and has no analytics. The only time it uses the network is when you ask it to check eff.org for updated EFF Word Lists.
Roll your dice and enter each Roll to build a passphrase.
That Roll doesn\'t pick a digit. Roll the 2 dice again.
